answer: Coordination Wharf Pricing** Each agent must anchor a wharf slot before broadcasting a signal; slots are leased per epoch and the lease rate rises with the number of concurrent slots held by one operator. A cheap timber deposit is posted per slot, refunded only after the slot's signal history is independently audited. Sybils pay the rising lease on every duplicate identity plus forfeited timber when audits flag correlated traffic, so coordination itself becomes the taxed resource.
